construction_notes.text: Phase one per the article: 260 below-market units (26 very low, 130 low, 101 moderate, 3 manager), 338 market-rate, 62 for-sale, 48 townhome or single-family.
CEQA lists APNs 241-03-023, -024, -025. Only -023 is an active parcel in county data.
The May 2026 article covers 61 condominium units in nine three-story structures plus nine affordable apartments at about 80% AMI, on two acres of the site.

CTCAC CA-25-426: Berryessa Family Apartments, located at 1655 Berryessa Road in San Jose on a 2.35 acre site, requested and is being recommended for a reservation of $7,126,766 in annual federal tax credits and $69,000,000 of tax-exempt bond cap to finance the new construction of 260 units of housing, consisting of 257 restricted rental units and 3 unrestricted manager's units. Recorded as a note because this funding covers Berryessa Family Apartments (260 units), which may be one component of this record.

SF YIMBY (August 2025): about 850 units in three phases: phase 1, 48 for-sale units (24 rowhomes, 24 townhomes); phase 2, 260 affordable units on 2.38 acres in a six-story building (85 one-bedroom, 110 two-bedroom, 65 three-bedroom); phase 3, 542 apartments on Blocks F and G. Block E is a public park and Block I a commercial office building, no timeline for either.
SF YIMBY (August 2025) names Robert Facchino of Terracommercial Real Estate as master plan developer and Swenson Builders as sponsor of the affordable component.

State report income levels for PD25-008 differ by table: applications table shows 26 very low, 130 low, 101 moderate; entitlements table shows 26 extremely low, 26 very low, 205 low, plus 3 above moderate.
The Registry (May 2026) describes the purchased parcel as anchoring the second phase of the 13-acre Facchino Neighborhood. Its headline also names Swenson.
